original.target_description: Original laboratory experiment, Section IV.B, Task-3 tournament-entry choice by gender: unconditional women-versus-men comparison, Fisher’s exact test on p. 1080. Task-3 sample documented in Tables I and II on p. 1081.

n.sample_role: Participants in the Task-3 tournament-choice comparison; forty women and forty men are mutually exclusive gender groups.
n.exclusions: No exclusions stated for this Task-3 comparison; Tables I and II identify the sample as forty women and forty men. Later belief-model exclusions do not apply to the unconditional comparison.
n.location: p. 1081, Table I sample note and Table II sample note; p. 1080, Section IV.B
n.quote: Sample is forty women and forty men.

es.quote:
Specifically, we find that 35 percent of
women and 73 percent of men select the tournament. This
observed gender gap in tournament entry is both substantial
and significant (a Fisher’s exact test yields p ⫽ .002).
